page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.48xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz.

This instance is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not feature any GPU accelerators.

For network connectivity, the ecs.r9i.48xlarge provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of memory relative to dedicated CPU cores makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, such as large-scale in-memory databases, heavy data processing pipelines, and enterprise resource planning applications.
